audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition: hasSeenDataColumnIndex() check (L157) and setSeenDataColumnIndex() call (subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go:42) are non-atomic. Multiple concurrent validation goroutines can all pass the deduplication check before any marks the key as seen, violating the 'first valid only' invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts identical data column sidecar to multiple peers simultaneously. Concurrent validateDataColumn() goroutines all check hasSeenDataColumnIndex() before any calls setSeenDataColumnIndex(), causing multiple acceptances of the same (slot, proposer_index, index) tuple.
